asset: Longitudinal TP2->TP1 registration — V&V enablement gate
source: Converged conclusion of the 2026-08-21 adversarial design+refute (workflow w3p81u3kz, 2 lanes + 2 skeptics). Both refuters ruled the flip UNSAFE on in-hand data.
rationale: The registration SERVICE runs in shadow (truthfully co-registered overlay, fewer misregistration false positives feeding the CANDIDATE counts) with registration_verified HARD-FALSE and the candidate firewall + report guard intact. Flipping to VERIFIED change is not permitted: the specified whole-brain-Dice QC saturates above the lesion length-scale (cannot certify lesion-scale alignment), and the in-hand data cannot measure the false-accept rate.

gate_1_failclosed_and_determinism.summary: Rigid-only (deformable banned + static-tested); threads pinned to 1 for reproducible MI sampling; fail-closed on non-finite / non-3D / degenerate brain mask / non-convergence / ITK error; registration_verified never true in the response contract. Recovery validated on a synthetic phantom AND on REAL MSLesSeg FLAIR anatomy (4 patients, injected 0-5mm rigid perturbation: post-reg brain-Dice stays flat at the unperturbed ceiling ~0.97 while pre-reg drops -> the optimizer recovers the offset). HONEST SCOPE (adversarial verification a03bbc02): real anatomy + real intensity but SYNTHETIC misalignment from the modelled rigid family (MSLesSeg is MNI-pre-aligned, so NO real inter-session misregistration exists); illustrative n=4, not powered; does NOT certify lesion-scale alignment (brain-Dice saturates) nor a production false-accept rate.
gate_1_failclosed_and_determinism.evidence: backend/app/services/registration_service.py; tests/unit/test_registration_failclosed.py (6 tests incl. synthetic recovery); docs/longitudinal-registration/real_flair_recovery_record.json (real-FLAIR optimizer recovery).

gate_2_lesion_scale_qc_metric.summary: The lesion-scale QC metric IS now implemented + fail-closed (registration_qc_service.lesion_scale_qc): worst-case matched-STABLE-fiducial centroid residual R_disp (mm), MUTUAL-best matching (kills the greedy neighbour-mismatch silent PASS), a COVERAGE guard (rejects centrally-clustered fiducials that cannot observe the rotational lever arm), fail-closed on <3 fiducials / no coverage / undefined. NCC arm demoted to advisory (not MI-independent + no in-hand intensity). This CLOSES the 'no lesion-scale gate exists' hole and supersedes whole-brain Dice as the flip QC. BUT it stays BLOCKED as a flip gate on two honest, MEASURED grounds: (a) on the 40 MSLesSeg pairs only 1/40 is MEASURABLE (39/40 have <3 large stable well-spread fiducials -> fail closed) — MS lesion morphology rarely provides the fiducials the metric needs; (b) that single measurable pair's jitter floor R_disp=1.33mm EXCEEDS the 1.0mm cut at ZERO registration error, so the cut has negative margin on the only real datum. Plus the registrar-in-the-loop test (Exp B) + NCC arm are FLAIR-blocked (no intensity in the staged cohort).
gate_2_lesion_scale_qc_metric.evidence: backend/app/services/registration_qc_service.py; tests/unit/test_registration_qc.py (8 tests: fail-closed matrix + catches a 3mm translation whole-brain Dice would rubber-stamp); docs/longitudinal-registration/jitter_floor_record.json (1/40 measurable, floor 1.33mm).

gate_3_deformable_ban_enforced.summary: Deformable registration banned (HAZ-LONG-2: a warp erases real lesion change). Enforced by a static test asserting no deformable-transform symbol in the service.

gate_4_qc_false_accept_measured.summary: The QC false-accept rate (QC-passed AND actually-misregistered) is the number the gate exists to produce. It CANNOT be measured on MSLesSeg: every pair is already on the identical MNI grid with zero misregistration, so the false-accept cell has no examples. Needs raw two-session intensity pairs with known/synthetic rigid perturbations across real scanners. (Mirror of CALM-MS Gate-7.)

gate_5_new_lesion_detection_validation.summary: New-lesion F1/LTPR/LFPR needs ADJUDICATED new-lesion labels (MSSEG-2-style). MSLesSeg per-timepoint total-lesion masks are NOT adjudicated for 'new', and 'GT2 minus GT1' is a confounded, non-registration-validating reference (already MNI-aligned). A DETECTION consistency-check on the 40 in-hand pairs is informative but is NOT safety evidence.

gate_6_report_firewall_interaction.summary: brain_report_service currently hard-forces verified=False and always candidate-frames (D4). Flipping registration_verified true would require editing that Class C module under review — out of scope until gates 2/4/5 pass. Until then the flip is cosmetic (report still candidate-frames) OR a dangerous regression; keep it dark.

gate_7_usability_and_pccp.summary: IEC 62366-1 summative usability (reader does not over-trust an unregistered/QC-advisory overlay) + per-operating-point clinical validation + PCCP. Do not exist.
